The floor is made of concrete and there are yellow bollards on the right side of the aisle. On the left side, there are stacks of boxes of various sizes and colors, including red, yellow, and white. The warehouse appears to be well-stocked with various items for sale. The ceiling is high and has several fluorescent lights. The overall atmosphere of the warehouse is busy and organized.
